images.title: Hydraulic Hose Fitting Assemblies
images.description: Complete fitting components combining hose connectors, ferrules, and threaded ends for dependable hydraulic hose connections.

images.title: Hydraulic Hose Ferrules (Crimping Sleeves)
images.description: Strong metal sleeves used to permanently crimp hydraulic hose fittings, providing a firm grip and leak-resistant connection.

images.title: Hydraulic Hose Nipples
images.description: Precision-engineered inserts that connect hydraulic hoses to fitting assemblies, ensuring secure attachment and efficient fluid flow.

images.title: Hydraulic Hose Fitting Nuts
images.description: Heavy-duty hexagonal nuts designed to secure hydraulic hose fittings and provide reliable threaded connections in hydraulic assemblies.

products.name: Custom Fittings
products.description:
When off-the-shelf fittings cannot meet space, port-routing, or thread transition requirements, SM Industries manufactures build-to-print special fittings directly from technical drawings, CAD models, or reference samples.

Available Material Options
Stainless Steel · Carbon & Alloy Steel · Brass · Aluminium Alloys

Typical Applications
Specialized fluid manifolds · Custom equipment retrofits · OEM assemblies

products.name: Hose End Fittings
products.description:
Manufactured to tight dimensional concentricity and clean thread profiles, our hose end fittings support secure crimping and reliable sealing across industrial fluid transfer assemblies. Available in standard and customer-specified configurations.

Available Material Options
Carbon Steel · Stainless Steel (SS 304 / SS 316) · Brass (On Request)

Typical Applications
Hydraulic hose assemblies · Industrial fluid lines · Mobile equipment

products.name: Hydraulic Fittings
products.description:
Our hydraulic fittings are machined from quality bar stock and forgings to deliver dependable structural integrity under operating pressure cycles. Every adapter and coupling undergoes thread and sealing-face checks before dispatch.

Available Material Options
Free-Cutting & Carbon Steel · Alloy Steel · Stainless Steel · Brass

Typical Applications
Hydraulic power packs · Earthmoving machinery · Industrial presses
